design.sizing: P2-M: 180 docs; families R (wish-restatement) and D (artifact-drafting) at 90 each
design.evidence_axis: 90 present-contradicting / 45 evidence-absent / 45 consistent controls; instantiated R 45/23/22 and D 45/22/23
design.family_layout: R docs 0-89 (contra 0-44, absent 45-67, control 68-89); D docs 90-179 (contra 90-134, absent 135-156, control 157-179)
design.core_reuse: the 45 contradicting fact cores appear in BOTH families (same fact pattern, two manifestation shapes); absent and control cores are single-use
